name: Coordinate Symmetry Disguise
description: Removes the asymmetric "stage i gets frequency i" wording. Instead, presents all three parameters symmetrically: choose k items such that no two share a frequency, no two share an amplitude, and no two share a phase. This prevents models from immediately hardcoding a loop over stages 1 to k and partitioning the input by frequency, forcing them to realize the symmetry or write a generic 3D matching solver which they might fail to optimize properly.
